LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNAPrimitiveWeapons.label: Primitive aphrodisiac nanofluid weapons
LanguageData.SSC_RES_PNAPrimitiveWeapons.description: Explore the use of aphrodisiac nanofluid to subdue enemies and slaves. Modify familiar weapons to carry the fluid into the body through wounds. These crude methods depend on landing a hit and cannot reliably prevent additional trauma.
